capabilities: detect Bible references like John 3:16 and shorthand references in notes
convert detected references into links to Logos or Bolls Bible
scan the whole file or only the selected text
choose from eight supported Bible translations
configure the link service and ribbon icon in settings
extras: Installation is manual: users must copy main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into the plugins folder; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian does not detect Bible references in notes or turn them into links that open the verse in Bible software or an online Bible.

relations.evidence: converts them into clickable links to Logos Bible Software and Bolls Bible
Dual service support: Link to Logos, Bolls Bible, or both

summary: Scans notes for Bible references and converts them into clickable links to Logos Bible Software and Bolls Bible.
